accounting.rationale: Normative statement-to-DIMENSION route for the listed objects. The actual scalar/array/assumed-rank classification, bounds, specification-expression and state interpretations retain8.5.8 and their canonical owners. No duplicate S rank/shape effect or no-op classifier is introduced.

8.5.1 permits an attribute specification statement as an explicit route. R851 does not reference an array element, allocate storage, invoke a procedure or read payload merely because parentheses appear.

8.5.8.1p1 includes scalar, assumed-rank and array entities. The array-name spelling is not an independent positive-rank constraint. Preserve zero-sized explicit-bounds-vector and RANK(0) classifications without confusing them with zero-sized positive-rank arrays.

Each named entity has its own required array-spec group. R851 spells the initial item and comma-led repetition explicitly; it is not a generic xyz-list wrapper or a shared single array-spec applied to every name.

PENDING exact source relations to R814 and its shape-category owners, C815/C816, declaration ordering, rank/corank and permitted constant-property inquiries. Existing C815_valid genuinely contains DIMENSION :: b(2), while the dimension-stmt deletion control does not; neither observation is retagged or automatically linked to numbered R851.

The original example supplies three different parenthesized array specifications in one statement. It does not supply all declarations, a dummy list, pointer/allocatable status or an executable value oracle.
The no-double-colon spelling is valid. Its comma-led repeated name/specification groups remain distinct from commas within an array-spec.
A(10) gives an explicit rank-one array specification. It is not the tenth element of an already declared array.
B(10,70) has its own rank-two specification. The internal comma separates dimensions; the preceding external comma separates statement items.

C(:) requires its actual canonical category. A nonallocatable nonpointer dummy can be assumed-shape, while an eligible POINTER/ALLOCATABLE object has deferred shape; a colon alone does not establish a legal ordinary local array.

PENDING a completed module procedure with typed ordinary A/B locals and a genuine nonallocatable nonpointer C dummy, whose explicit interface makes the illustrated assumed-shape choice valid. No call or uninitialized data/shape inquiry is required for a syntax control, and no example-only execution is counted.

requirements.title: A DIMENSION statement contains one required name/specification pair and optional repeated pairs
requirements.source: 8.6.8 R851, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF138, printed124.
requirements.definition: DIMENSION has an optional double colon, then a required array-name followed by its required parenthesized array-spec. Zero or more additional groups each begin with a comma and contain their own name and parenthesized array-spec. This is the explicit R851 repetition, not an xyz-list wrapper or optional per-item shape suffix. The name uses the assumed R402 convention; the complete original grammar-head census has no explicit array-name production. R814 and its canonical conditions determine the entity's rank/category, which need not be positive merely because the term is array-name.

pending.double-colon-form: PENDING compile/positive-control: a complete ordinary program with INTEGER :: a, no earlier DIMENSION/RANK/array-spec, followed by DIMENSION :: a(3). Parentheses specify the entity's dimensions rather than an element reference. No initialization or value inquiry is needed for syntax admission.
pending.no-double-colon-form: PENDING the otherwise equivalent complete DIMENSION a(3) form, retaining type, scope, name and array specification. The double colon is optional; the name and parenthesized array-spec are not.
pending.repeated-name-specification-pairs: PENDING complete controls for DIMENSION :: a(2), b(2,3), with separately typed names and no competing dimension specification. Complete the original note in a module procedure with typed ordinary A/B locals and an actual C dummy for C(:). Each item gets its own specification; distinguish item-separating commas from those inside one array-spec.
pending.missing-first-item: PENDING complete specification-part contrasts with DIMENSION alone and DIMENSION :: alone, repaired only by inserting a(2) for a prior-typed eligible name with no previous dimension specification. Require the missing name/specification-item cause, not generic EOF/missing-END, a missing module or a duplicate attribute.
pending.missing-per-item-specification: PENDING complete contexts with DIMENSION :: a and separately DIMENSION :: a(2), b, repaired only by adding the omitted (2) or (3) group to the affected item. A/B have type declarations but no earlier array-spec/RANK. Prior shape elsewhere does not make a bare item valid R851 syntax, and adding a second explicit DIMENSION is not a conforming repair.
pending.delimiter-and-separator-repairs: PENDING separately isolated missing closing-parenthesis, missing comma between two complete pairs, and trailing-comma contrasts in otherwise complete typed contexts. Repair only the selected delimiter/separator. Keep each array-spec valid and each name distinct; no wrong bound type/rank, repeated attribute or unsupported vector-bound feature may provide the diagnosis.
pending.name-versus-designator-source: PENDING original-name and declaration-role relations for whole named objects versus percent components, array elements/sections and function-reference values. R851 contains array-name plus a declaration array-spec, not a data-ref. A component contrast needs a complete type/base definition and a whole-name repair whose final type/shape/attributes remain valid; otherwise hold the case instead of borrowing a scalar-parent repair or treating actual element indexing as dimensions.
pending.explicit-shape-and-specification-bounds: PENDING complete fixed-bound INTEGER controls with a(2,3) and b(0:1,-1:1), plus a separate module procedure with a previously typed nonoptional INTEGER INTENT(IN) bound source n and DIMENSION a(n). C831 and10.1.11 govern allowed nonconstant specifications. Bounds/entry-capture runtime effects stay at8.5.8.2; undefined local payload is not read merely to make this grammar observable.
pending.deferred-shape-controls: PENDING complete local INTEGER POINTER and ALLOCATABLE declarations without an earlier DIMENSION, followed by DIMENSION :: p(:), a(:,:). C834 supplies the deferred-shape/rank conditions; this statement does not allocate or associate them. No SIZE/SHAPE/LBOUND/UBOUND or payload query occurs while those properties are unavailable.
pending.remaining-array-spec-category-source: PENDING finite R814 source/admission relations for genuine assumed-shape dummies, assumed-size dummies, implied-shape named constants and assumed-rank dummies, including their vector/list variants. Preserve C835/C837/C838, constant initialization for named constants, C839/C840 and required explicit interfaces. A spelling such as colon or star alone does not establish a legal category. Corank belongs to CODIMENSION, not square brackets appended to R851, and C822 plus actual pointer/allocatable/coarray constraints remain canonical.
pending.scalar-zero-bound-vector-boundary: PENDING source-qualified complete admission using a prior constant rank-one zero-sized INTEGER bounds vector, for example INTEGER, PARAMETER :: ub(0)=[INTEGER ::], an independently typed ordinary x and DIMENSION :: x(ub). C833 and8.5.8.2p1 make the resulting entity scalar because the vector size is zero. Contrast x(0), which is a rank-one zero-sized array. RANK(0) supplies a separate canonical scalar classification, not permission to omit R851's group or duplicate DIMENSION. Any later rank observation targets the actual declared x and independent literal0, not RANK of the bounds constructor or a fixed-rank proxy; unsupported syntax is not a reason to replace this boundary.
pending.prior-specification-and-inquiry-source: PENDING complete statement-order and constant-property contexts under8.2,10.1.11p6/p7 and10.1.12p1(6)/p2. Establish types and relevant properties before dependent inquiries; an inquiry can be a constant expression when the property queried is neither assumed nor deferred nor defined nonconstantly, without reading an ordinary variable's value. Do not require every object to be PARAMETER or treat every inquiry on unavailable data as valid. Do not combine a RANK clause, entity array-spec and DIMENSION statement without proving the specific override/uniqueness conditions.
pending.scope-and-canonical-witness-source: PENDING exact USE/HOST/BLOCK and function-result relations.14.2.2p9 does not permit DIMENSION re-attribution of a USE-associated entity;19.5.1.4p2 names an array-name in a DIMENSION statement as a local identifier, and11.1.4p2/19.4 define BLOCK construct entities. Complete local typing avoids a false claim that an outer object's shape changed. A function result keeps C816/C1570 and result-definition duties. C815_valid has a real DIMENSION :: b(2) and retains its mixed-specification run/effect role; C815_invalid:dimension-stmt remains a duplication case, and its deletion control contains no R851 statement. No numbered-wrapper link, clone or retag is approved.

requirements.oracle: Complete compile/positive-controls for the actual explicit-pair grammar and narrowly repaired syntax failures, with names, type/shape roles, scope and earlier specifications independently valid. Canonical array-category/property and inquiry relationships remain explicit pending source gates. A statement spelling is not a runtime rank/shape/allocation observation.
requirements.oracle_limitation: All facets are pending. Numbered reporting capability does not mandate fatal rejection, exact English or a printed R851. Generic array, bound or expected-token text alone is insufficient; actual causal grammar and live-source origins must be qualified. Wrong type/rank, duplicate attributes, unprovided modules/interfaces, unsupported facilities, source echoes, quoted examples, Internal/ASR/verifier failures, crashes and resource failures earn no credit. Scalar rank zero and zero-sized positive-rank arrays remain distinct. No unallocated/undefined payload, guessed shape, constructor-rank proxy or compile-only downgrade of a required canonical runtime effect is introduced.

review_rationale: Independent complete original DIMENSION statement source and pending plans reviewed in receipt12c752e5dd21c9e0273b130de1b3415bd8189f33bd4416440f9394b06c149ba9 and registered in doc/source_audits/batch_074.json. R851's explicit first name(array-spec) plus comma-led repetition is not replaced by an assumed generic list; each required group and optional double colon are retained. R402 supplies array-name, not a positive-rank assumption: a qualifying zero-sized rank-one bound vector can declare rank0, distinct from a size0 rank1 array. A later actual-object RANK inquiry needs original prior-property conditions and is not a constructor proxy. Shape/category/type/scope/constant-expression and C864 routes remain canonical; a prior-type control does not invent universal declaration ordering. The p1 route and note create no local S classifier. All pending syntax/property/canonical/source-use facets remain unimplemented; old C815 deletion controls are not positive statement occurrences.
